assay_lineage_dependence.description: Nellist/Erasmus parental-HEK293/HEK293T functional-assay and construct lineage; repeated positive-control use is not independent replication.
Nellist/Erasmus CRISPR 3H9-1B1 double-knockout assay generation reused across 2020-2024 papers.
Independent Pam/MYCBP2 ubiquitination laboratory; imports the R611Q binding premise.
Patient-621 R611Q-plus-LOH tumor and derivative 621-101/621-327 lineage; derivatives are not independent allele models.
Independent endogenous cliPE program plus later integrated MAVE/VAMP work; publication and released datasets must be deduplicated.
External laboratory using R611Q plasmids supplied by Mark Nellist.
Independent clinical molecular cohorts/cases; occurrence does not establish mechanism.
Independent non-mTOR cell-cycle study; allele-specific extraction incomplete.
General HERC1/Hsp90/TSC1 proteostasis mechanisms without R611Q testing.
Wild-type structural and GAP-biochemistry studies; no mutant or ligand-bound R611Q structure.

propositions.conclusion: R611Q recurs in clinical and tumor reports; occurrence and phenotype do not establish a RescueScreen mechanism.
propositions.proposition: R611Q was observed in a reported person, family, cohort, or tumor.

propositions.conclusion: The exact score is fixed; its categorical interpretation changed with calibration version.
propositions.proposition: R611Q has an allele-specific cliPE CMAS observation.

propositions.conclusion: Direct co-IP/binding support exists, concentrated in the Nellist lineage; several later sources measure associated TSC1/TSC2 signals rather than binding itself.
propositions.proposition: R611Q reduces TSC1 binding or TSC-complex formation/associated TSC1 abundance.

propositions.conclusion: No direct-binding, stabilization, complex-rescue, or functional-rescue compound has been reported for R611Q in this corpus.
propositions.proposition: A compound directly binds and stabilizes/rescues R611Q TSC2.

propositions.conclusion: No R611Q-specific degron was mapped; loss of TSC1 protection is an alternative explanation.
propositions.proposition: R611Q creates or exposes a defined degron.

propositions.conclusion: Wild-type coordinates exist, but no mutant structure, residue-specific contact proof, pocket calculation, fragment screen, or ligand-bound structure was found.
propositions.proposition: R611Q has a validated ligandable/druggable pocket or defined Arg611-TSC1 contact.

propositions.conclusion: Rapalogs suppress downstream pathway/tumor readouts in several R611Q-containing contexts, but no source shows stabilization or restored R611Q complex/GAP function.
propositions.proposition: Rapalog treatment suppresses downstream mTORC1 readouts in an R611Q-containing context.

propositions.conclusion: No study restored abundance/complex formation and then measured intrinsic Rheb-GTP hydrolysis.
propositions.proposition: R611Q retains intrinsic Rheb-GAP activity after abundance and complex formation are restored.

propositions.conclusion: No direct folding, aggregation, thermal-stability, limited-proteolysis, or hydrophobic-exposure assay was found.
propositions.proposition: R611Q directly misfolds, aggregates, or exposes hydrophobic surface.

propositions.conclusion: Low-throughput support is concentrated in related overexpression lineages. The independent cliPE score is indeterminate under 2024 thresholds and abnormal under the 2026 cutoff; this is calibration dependence, not biological contradiction.
propositions.proposition: R611Q impairs TSC-complex-dependent suppression of mTORC1/TORC1 readouts.

propositions.conclusion: Pam/MYCBP2-associated ubiquitination is directly observed once; proteasomal turnover and rescue are not demonstrated.
propositions.proposition: R611Q remains susceptible to Pam/MYCBP2-associated ubiquitination despite TSC1 co-expression.

propositions.conclusion: Multiple overexpression assays and an independent R611Q VAMP-seq row support lower steady-state abundance; this is not a half-life or folding measurement.
propositions.proposition: R611Q lowers steady-state TSC2 abundance in the stated assay.

propositions.conclusion: Several tumors show R611Q with LOH/copy loss; these biallelic tumor contexts are not heterozygous patient-cell models.
propositions.proposition: R611Q occurred with loss/inactivation of the other TSC2 allele in the reported tumor context.

propositions.conclusion: No R611Q-specific half-life, cycloheximide chase, MG132 rescue, or proteasome-dependent turnover result was found.
propositions.proposition: R611Q has a measured shortened half-life or demonstrated proteasome-dependent turnover.

propositions.conclusion: The released R611Q VAMP row is functionally_abnormal for steady-state GFP-fusion abundance; it does not demonstrate misfolding or turnover.
propositions.proposition: R611Q has an allele-specific VAMP-seq abundance observation.
